sources.supports: Anthropic's own price table on June 20, before the models.dev correction, lists the Haiku 3 5-minute cache write as $0.30/MTok and cache hits as $0.03/MTok, alongside input $0.25 and output $1.25.

sources.quote: Claude Haiku 3 | $0.25 / MTok | $0.30 / MTok | $0.50 / MTok | $0.03 / MTok | $1.25 / MTok
sources.supports: The June 24 Anthropic table repeats the same prices immediately after the models.dev record, with no indicated price change.

notes: Anthropic's June 20 table predates the reported models.dev correction and shows $0.30/MTok for 5-minute cache writes and $0.03/MTok for cache hits; June 24 repeats the same row. The earlier models.dev value therefore appears to have put the cache-read price in the cache-write field. No provider price change or effective date is evidenced.
